A hand-painted stay · Cheoc Van

01

The hotel

A retreat between village and sea

A Quiet Side
of Macao

Pousada do Silêncio is a proposed four-star boutique leisure hotel near Cheoc Van Beach in Coloane.

It brings together accommodation, local culture, optional sensory experiences and slow exploration of the surrounding community—giving each guest room to notice what is usually passed by.

Read our story →
CoastNatureScentCraftCommunity

The mark we carry

Inspired by Coloane

The emblem is a small landscape: coastal waves below bamboo leaves, held together by a warm, flowing line. It speaks of scent moving through air—and of a hotel connected to its community and environment.

Coast / wavesNature / bambooMemory / scentCommunity / circle

Second-floor dining · Coast in view

Dining at
Pousada

A quiet room above the arcades, where coastal light settles across timber tables and hand-painted Portuguese tiles.

Natural wood, woven rattan and open arched windows create an unhurried dining atmosphere shaped by the colours and character of Coloane.
